title: the hostname lookup is copied nine times across lib and liberators, and desktop.sh has drifted
body: The hostname lookup `hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname` is copied across lib/molt.sh and the liberators, and one copy has drifted: liberators/desktop.sh:23 falls back to the string "unknown" instead of the long hostname, so a host whose `hostname -s` fails looks for `instances/unknown/`. ST0006 WP01 (st0006-wp01 28062ea) lands `molt_hostname` in lib/molt.sh, which cuts at the first dot and fails when the host has no name, and moves the lib copies, tiling and backup onto it. Six liberator copies remain: desktop.sh:23, keys.sh:65, ssh.sh:32, ssh.sh:95 (the email fallback) and ssh.sh:119, zsh.sh:42. Fix, after WP01 merges: every remaining copy calls `molt_hostname` (Highlander), with a test that pins desktop against the drift. Owner: molt-dc.
